Lonely in London? Sauna as the new place to socialise... 🌀

London can be such a fun and busy city. But, despite being surrounded by so many people, us Londoners are feeling increasingly isolated.

Many of us are working from home. Typical social spaces revolve around alcohol and aren’t designed to help you meet new people. So, we’ve built a new kind of space...

When we opened last Autumn, we were chasing a dream we couldn’t quite find anywhere else.

A place to connect with people, listen to amazing music, and leave feeling really (really) good. All without the pressure to consume alcohol or any of nightlife’s other excesses.

Don’t get us wrong, London is home to SO many amazing independent nighttime venues, with incredible music programming. These venues still hold a special place in our hearts.

But the loneliness epidemic is real, and we wanted to create a space that truly brings people together. 

So whether you sauna for your physical health, mental health, or social connection - come alone or with friends. Everyone is welcome.

We can’t wait to meet you 🫧

When we opened our shutters in August 2024, it wasn’t just about building a business. It was about building the kind of Social Club we wished existed in London 🫧

So much of social life here is often centred around alcohol, with pubs and clubs the default for meeting friends or hearing new music. Our question was: what if you put sauna and ice bathing in its place? Instead of waking up with a hangover, you wake up feeling healthy and well-rested?

That spark of an idea became Sauna Social Club. A space for music, creativity and connection. A place where you might find yourself meditating to music in the listening sauna, sharing conversations in the chatty sauna, plunging into the ice baths, or simply curling up with a book.

With our backgrounds in the arts, social work, fitness and community organising, we set out to bring people together in a way that supports both health and creativity.

One year on, this feels less like our project and more like a community. Together we’ve created a new kind of social club — a place to connect, relax and be inspired. This film shares the story of how it all began.

Thank you to everyone who has joined us along the way. We could not have done it without you. Hope to see you in the sauna this winter!

With love,
Nikki & Benji x

Hi, I’m Mary Ann Botero — Founder & Trauma-Informed Facilitator of Sana Social Club 🌿

I’m a Licensed Social Worker (LSW) in the state of Illinois with over four years of experience supporting students, families, and communities across the Chicagoland area. A Dominican University graduate (2022), I also hold a Professional Educator License (PEL) in School Social Work and EMDR trained in trauma-informed care, poly vagal & nervous system regulation, and relational healing.

In addition to my clinical background, I am completing my certification in Mat Pilates, which I integrate as a somatic and body-based approach to support emotional regulation, embodiment, and overall wellness.

Sana Social Club was created from a deep understanding that many adults are navigating the lasting impact of parent wounds, family dynamics, and generational patterns—often without spaces that feel safe, supportive, and accessible.

Through Sana, I offer trauma-informed group experiences, healing circles, workshops, and somatic practices designed to help you reconnect with yourself, regulate your nervous system, and build healthier relationships in community.

This is not therapy. This is a space for education, connection, and embodied healing.

If you’re ready to do the work in a way that feels grounded, supported, and communal—welcome to Sana Social Club.

Healing happens together 🤍

There’s something so special about gathering in community, under the open sky, and allowing ourselves the space to simply be. 🌿✨

Today’s Sana Social Club Summer Sound Bath Series at Mary Bartelme Park was everything my heart needed. We grounded with nature, practiced somatic breathwork, reflected through journaling, spoke life into ourselves with affirmations, and surrendered to the healing vibrations of a deeply restorative sound bath. Watching so many first-time participants relax, release, and embrace the experience reminded me exactly why I created this space.

We closed our afternoon with beautiful tarot readings, each one offering messages that seemed to arrive exactly when they were needed. Moments like these are a reminder that healing doesn’t have to happen alone—it flourishes in safe, supportive community.

A huge thank you to Nelly’s Café & Sweets for treating us to the most nostalgic drink of the day: the Fruity Pebbles Matcha. 💚 It was creamy, delicious, and instantly brought me back to the joy of eating a bowl of Fruity Pebbles as a kid. A little sip of nostalgia that definitely healed a piece of my inner child.

My heart is so full. Thank you to every woman who showed up with an open heart, trusted the process, and allowed herself to receive. Thank you for reminding me that when women gather with intention, healing, connection, and a little bit of magic naturally unfold. Until August 30th. ✨🤍

☕ Introducing Sunday Pour

A signature gathering by Sana Social Club🌿

Where people gather to pour back into themselves.

I’ve always believed that healing doesn’t only happen in a therapy office or during a sound bath. Sometimes it happens over a warm cup of coffee, in meaningful conversation, and in the presence of people who make you feel seen.

As a Licensed Clinical Social Worker, EMDR-trained therapist, certified Sound Bath Practitioner, and founder of Sana Social Club, I’m creating this space with intention for anyone looking to slow down, reflect, and reconnect with themselves in community.

Join me for a cozy Sunday morning featuring guided reflection, thoughtful conversation, journaling prompts, and questions designed to encourage self-awareness and meaningful discussion. You’ll also have the opportunity to receive a tarot spread and/or an oracle card pull as a tool for personal reflection and insight along with guided reflection prompts. 

No prior experience is needed, and no pressure to share more than you’re comfortable with. This is simply a welcoming space to pause, connect, and pour back into yourself.

☕Sunday, August 2nd
☕️Sunday, August 16th
☕️Sunday, August 30th
